## Add to iOS Simulator, Right From Finder

Select photos or videos in Finder, right-click, and choose **Add to iOS Simulator**. Your selection goes directly into the target simulator's **Photos library**.

- **One running simulator:** imports immediately.
- **Multiple running simulators:** choose by device name, iOS version, and running state.
- **None running:** select an available device; MacRightClick boots it, waits until it is ready, then imports.
- Supports multi-select, paths with spaces, and success/failure feedback.
- Uses Apple's `simctl addmedia` with an explicit device UUID. Requires Xcode, an installed iOS runtime, and an available simulator.

## Also in This Version

- English and Simplified Chinese menus and simulator dialogs follow your system language.
- Updated for macOS 27 and Xcode 27, retaining macOS 14+ support.
- New app icon with light and neutral black dark appearances.
- Copy Path, PDF to JPG at 200 DPI, and AVI to MP4 remain available.

## Download

Download **MacRightClick.dmg**, drag the app to **Applications**, and enable **Mac RightClick** in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions > Finder Extensions. Relaunch Finder after replacing an older version.

Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel. App and extension version: **1.1.0 (2)**.

This GitHub build is **ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized**. macOS may block its first launch; after verifying the download, use the app-specific **Open Anyway** option in Privacy & Security if offered. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally. A SHA-256 checksum is included with the download.

## Finder 右键，直接添加到 iOS 模拟器

在 Finder 选中图片或视频，右键选择 **添加到 iOS 模拟器**，即可导入目标模拟器的照片图库。

- 只有一台正在运行的模拟器时，直接导入。
- 多台运行时，按设备名称、iOS 版本和运行状态选择。
- 没有运行设备时，选择可用设备，自动启动并等待完成后导入。
- 支持多选、带空格的路径，以及成功或失败反馈。
- 使用明确的设备 UUID 调用 Apple `simctl addmedia`，需要 Xcode、iOS runtime 和可用模拟器。

同时带来跟随系统语言的中英文菜单、macOS 27 适配，以及浅色和中性黑色的全新图标。原有复制路径、PDF 转 JPG 和 AVI 转 MP4 功能保留。

下载 **MacRightClick.dmg**，拖入 Applications 并启用 Finder 扩展；覆盖旧版后请重新启动 Finder。支持 Apple silicon 和 Intel，最低 macOS 14。

此 GitHub 构建采用 **ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Developer ID 签名或完成公证**。首次启动可能被 macOS 拦截；确认下载可信后，可使用“隐私与安全性”中针对此 App 的“仍要打开”（如有显示），无需全局关闭 Gatekeeper。附件包含 SHA-256 校验文件。
